title: Things to Do in Rajgir: Vulture's Peak, Peace Pagoda, Hot Springs & Nalanda
seoTitle: Things to Do in Rajgir: Stupa, Springs & Nalanda | Kudozz Club
description: Things to do in Rajgir: the ropeway to the Vishwa Shanti Stupa, Vulture's Peak where the Buddha taught, the hot springs of Brahmakund, Saptaparni Cave, Bimbisara's Jail, the Cyclopean Wall, Venuvana, Jain temples on the hills, the glass bridge, Ghora Katora lake and the ruins of Nalanda.
dek: The ancient capital of Magadha, ringed by five hills, where the Buddha and Mahavira taught, and a short drive from the ruins of Nalanda.
searchIntent: Pilgrims and history lovers planning one or two days in Rajgir and Nalanda, often with Bodh Gaya.

hero.caption: Vishwa Shanti Stupa

intro: Rajgir (ancient Rajagriha) was the first capital of the Magadha kingdom, ruled by Bimbisara and Ajatashatru in the 6th and 5th centuries BCE. The Buddha spent many rainy seasons here and gave important sermons on Vulture's Peak, and Mahavira, the 24th Jain Tirthankara, also lived and taught here. After the Buddha's death, the first Buddhist council was held in a cave in the hills.

The things to do in Rajgir include the ropeway up Ratnagiri hill to the white Vishwa Shanti Stupa, the walk to Vulture's Peak, the hot springs at the foot of Vaibhar hill, ancient ruins such as Bimbisara's Jail and the Cyclopean Wall, Jain temples on the hills, newer attractions such as the glass bridge and nature safari, and a visit to Nalanda's ruins nearby.
One to two days is enough. October to March is the best time; the Rajgir Mahotsav is held in autumn or winter.

items.name: Ride the ropeway to the Vishwa Shanti Stupa
body: The Vishwa Shanti Stupa, a white peace pagoda built by the Japanese Nipponzan Myohoji order and inaugurated in 1969, stands on Ratnagiri hill with gold statues of the Buddha in four niches. A chairlift and a newer cabin ropeway run up the hill.

From the top, paths lead across the ridge towards Vulture's Peak, and a Japanese temple beside the stupa holds daily prayers with drums. Early morning, before the crowds and heat, is the calmest time.

items.name: Walk up to Vulture's Peak
body: Griddhakuta, or Vulture's Peak, is a rocky outcrop where the Buddha is believed to have given many sermons, including teachings associated with the Lotus Sutra. A stone path leads up to the remains of brick platforms, where pilgrims pray and meditate.

items.name: See Saptaparni Cave
body: Saptaparni Cave, on Vaibhar hill, is where the first Buddhist council was held after the Buddha's passing to compile his teachings. It is reached by a steep climb.

items.name: Walk in Venuvana
body: Venuvana, a bamboo grove gifted to the Buddha by King Bimbisara, is now a landscaped park with a pond, a peaceful spot to rest.

items.name: Visit Bimbisara's Jail
body: The ruins known as Bimbisara's Jail mark where King Bimbisara is said to have been imprisoned by his son Ajatashatru. According to tradition, he chose this site because he could see the Buddha on Vulture's Peak from here.

items.name: See the Cyclopean Wall
body: The Cyclopean Wall, a massive dry-stone wall that once ran for about 40 km around the city, is one of the oldest stone structures in India, dating from before the Mauryan period.

items.name: See the Swarna Bhandar caves
body: The Son Bhandar caves, two rock-cut chambers with Jain inscriptions, are linked in local legend to a hidden treasure.

sections.heading: Hot springs, Jain temples and new attractions

items.name: Bathe at the Brahmakund hot springs
body: At the foot of Vaibhar hill, hot springs feed bathing tanks at the Brahmakund, where pilgrims bathe for their healing properties. It is busy in winter and during festivals.

items.name: Visit the Jain temples
body: The five hills around Rajgir have Jain temples on their summits, reached by steps, as Mahavira spent many monsoons here. Pawapuri, where Mahavira attained nirvana, is about 35 km away and has the white Jal Mandir in a lotus pond.

items.name: Walk the glass bridge
body: The Rajgir Nature Safari, opened in recent years, has a glass skywalk bridge suspended over a valley, zip lines and a safari zone. The Rajgir Zoo Safari nearby has big cats and other animals in large enclosures.

items.name: Relax at Ghora Katora
body: Ghora Katora, a lake surrounded by hills in a protected area, has a large Buddha statue in the water and electric boats. Only non-polluting transport is allowed on the approach.

items.name: Explore the ruins of Nalanda
body: Nalanda, about 15 km north, was one of the greatest centres of learning in the ancient world, flourishing from the 5th to 12th centuries, with thousands of students and teachers. Its red-brick monasteries, temples and stupas, including the great Sariputta Stupa, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The site museum and the Xuanzang Memorial Hall are nearby.

image.alt: Ruins of Nalanda and the Sariputta Stupa
image.caption: Nalanda Mahavihara

items.name: October to March
body: Pleasant weather for walking the hills and ruins; the Rajgir Mahotsav cultural festival is held in this season.

items.name: July to September
body: Monsoon rains green the hills; some trails are slippery.

byTraveller.text: Vulture's Peak at dawn, the Peace Pagoda, Saptaparni and Nalanda.
The ropeway, the glass bridge, the zoo safari and Ghora Katora.
Nalanda, Bimbisara's Jail and the Cyclopean Wall.

oneDay: Walk up to Vulture's Peak at dawn and take the ropeway to the Vishwa Shanti Stupa. After breakfast, visit Venuvana, Bimbisara's Jail and the hot springs, then drive to Nalanda for the afternoon.
tips: The nearest airports are Gaya and Patna; Rajgir has a railway station.
Bihar is a dry state; alcohol is prohibited.
Book nature and zoo safari tickets in advance.
Carry water and a hat for the hill climbs.

faqs.q: What are the best things to do in Rajgir?
faqs.a: Ride the ropeway to the Vishwa Shanti Stupa, walk up to Vulture's Peak, bathe at the hot springs, see Saptaparni Cave, Bimbisara's Jail and the Cyclopean Wall, walk the glass bridge and visit Nalanda.

faqs.q: How far is Nalanda from Rajgir?
faqs.a: About 15 km, roughly 30 minutes by road.

faqs.q: How many days are enough for Rajgir?
faqs.a: One to two days, including Nalanda.
Yes. The Nalanda Mahavihara was inscribed in 2016.
